title: Provider Quota config
description: Plugin config persisted under plugins['quota'].* in ~/.pi/dashboard/config.json. Read by the server entry. Every gate defaults OFF and is NEVER turned on by migration/upgrade.

enabled.description: Master gate. When false the server entry makes no subscription-quota endpoint call and /api/quota returns no providers.

acknowledgedToS.description: One-time acknowledgement that quota tracking calls undocumented provider endpoints that may violate provider terms; personal/local use only. No quota fetch occurs until this is true.

providers.description: Per-provider enablement, keyed by provider id (e.g. openai-codex, github-copilot). Each provider is OFF by default and enabled individually. Anthropic is excluded and ignored if present.
